chapter_seo_title: Chapter 516: A Declaration of War – Ji Ning Chooses His Side
chapter_meta_description: With war looming between the Grand Xia and Seamless Gate, Ji Ning must relocate his clan and prepare for battle. Learn which ancient clan has defected in secret.
og_title: The Grand Xia War Begins: Ji Ning's Choice
og_description: The Seamless Gate declares open war. Ji Ning moves his clan into a pocket world and prepares to fight for the Xia Emperor.
twitter_title: War in the Three Realms: Ji Ning Prepares
twitter_description: The Seamless Gate makes its move. Ji Ning relocates his family into a Pure Yang treasure and heads to the war council.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-grade magic treasure that requires at least Celestial Immortal-level ki to refine; far superior to Earth and Heaven-grade treasures.
A Pure Yang treasure containing a minor pocket world, used here by Ji Ning to relocate his entire clan and preserve Winged Serpent Lake.
A powerful but extremely low-key ancient tribe of the Grand Xia Dynasty that has secretly defected to the Seamless Gate.
A cultivator who failed the Heavenly Tribulation and escaped with their soul; they slowly decay over time unless they can transcend.
A major Daofather of the Three Realms; the Xia Emperor is a member of his faction against the Seamless Gate.
Semi-autonomous rulers of commanderies in the Grand Xia Dynasty, often from ancient bloodlines.
A veteran Celestial Immortal allied with Ji Ning and the Anchan Northmont clan, knowledgeable about ancient secrets.
Ji Ning's residence on Winged Serpent Lake; the gathering place for his closest allies and family.
